notes.title: Major Update: "Graphic Reimagined" is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Hey everyone, it's Circuit Art!
Today, we are thrilled to announce the latest free update for our project, The Last Soldier of the Ming Dynasty. 

[b]However, please notice that the save files from legacy version won't work after the update, but you can still continue your old save files by following steps: [/b]
[list]
[*]Right-click game title on your Steam Library view
[*]Click properties
[*]Click Betas (on the left side-bar)
[*]Select vanilla - OG Last Soldier on "Beta Participation" tag (which displays "NONE" by default)
[/list]
Then the game will start on legacy version. We apologize for any inconvinience it may cause. This major update gives the game brand-new visual effects, which means we have to rewrite the structure of data totally, makes it impossible to be compatible with old save files.
 
This update is a big one, so sit back, relax, and get ready to enjoy this exciting new journey with the Last Soldier!
 
We implemented major changes to optimise the framerate and redesigned the characters, as well as made adjustments to the early stages of the game to enhance the gaming experience. Additionally, we have improved the lighting to create a more vivid environment.
 
Here’s the detailed update note:
[list]
[*]              Optimization of performance by adjusting the original map
[*]              Character redesign
[*]              Introducing lightning to the environment
[*]              Adjustment to the weapons 
[*]              Adjustment to the tutorial
[*]              Adjustment to the special effects for better performance
[*]              Adjustment to the character battle animations
[*]              Adjustment to the character’s standing pose
[*]              Adjustment to the UI for better performance
[*]              Fast travel system improvement 
[/list]
We have been facing difficulties as an indie game studio since December of last year. While we have received advice from many people to focus on our next game and not struggle with the current one, we, as a three-person studio, have decided to put all our efforts into improving the current game as if it were our last. Despite downsizing the studio and facing some struggles, we are determined to make this game better.

We hope that you enjoy playing our game and that we won't have any regrets in the future.

-              Character redesign
-              Introducing lightning to the environment

notes.title: Major Update is Coming! #2 Environment
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=TQs9G-2wQbo;full][/previewyoutube]
Hello everyone, this is Circuit_Art. In the last issue, we previewed the remake of our character models, and today we'd like share the recent environment update with you.

Light and shadow processing in a game affects the overall visual effects of the game, and we have been learning a lot about light and shadow processing on the development of The Last Soldier of the Ming Dynasty. In the next major update, we will add more lighting details on the original style of the game's graphics, so as to improve the visual effects of various scenes.

This major update will be released with the DLC because of its size. 

Next, we will continue to optimize the gameplay.

notes.title: Major Update is Coming! #1 Characters
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=HIfZVu86hac;full][/previewyoutube]
Hello everyone! This is Circuit_Art. As you may have noticed, The Last Soldier of the Ming Dynasty has not been updated since January. Don't worry, we just being busy on some major updates for the game that will take more time and effort to complete.

In short, we adjust the character body types to make them look more normal, based on feedback from a wide range of players.

This is a difficult decision for us. It will not affect the gameplay, but we have to change a lot of work we have done before. We knew that such a change might upset some players who preferred the original style of the characters, and these models may not be as beautiful as other similar action games for now. However, we finally decided to make these changes, because we realize it may not only bring players a better gaming experience, but also pave the way for subsequent updates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44387075/460eaf7490966e8945628921454a25d3ad2e46e1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44387075/2bbecd5a73ea7af0cca5b86351418f11ed612b82.png[/img]

Also, a new DLC will be released with the next major update, which contains new battlegrounds, new enemies, and much more.

Thank you for your patience and support. We will try our best to bring all of you a better experience!

tags.feature: Also, a new DLC will be released with the next major update, which contains new battlegrounds, new enemies, and much more.

notes.title: What we want to convey to players and the following update plan
notes.content:
Hello everyone, we are Circuit_Art.

The first indie game we developed, "The Last Soldier of the Ming Dynasty", has been officially released for a week!

We have seen many players like our game and think it is fun in the last week, which let us be greatly inspired. As an action game, what could be more exciting for us than the action system is loved by players?

There are still many problems that need to be fixed in the game, including insufficient optimization, button settings are not friendly, the teaching system needs to be improved, etc., but we are still grateful for the support and tolerance from the players and the community. Every player's praise and suggestions are the driving force for our progress and the source of our continuous efforts.

We know that player feedback is the key to continually improve our games. Therefore, we will take every player’s opinion and suggestion seriously and use them as an important basis for us to improve the game.

Since the game was launched, we have carried out 5 version updates, mainly to fix some problems that seriously affect the players' experience. In the future, we will continue to optimize and fix known problems to create better quality for our players.

At the same time, we are also continuing to develop the subsequent content of the game. On December 15th, we will launch updates to the Arena mode and Survival mode.

-Arena mode: After players clear the game, they can unlock the BOSS rush mode. Choose equipment, weapons, accessories, and select bonus attributes in stages to challenge the increasingly stronger BOSS in the arena!
-Survival mode: In non-stop combats, survive the longest!

We will also add a challenge mode in subsequent updates to provide more challenges for players.
-Challenge mode: Create the fastest kill time and the highest kill damage!

Thank you again to all the players for your tolerance and recognition of us. We will continue to work hard to live up to your expectations. If you encounter any problems during the game, or have any comments or suggestions about the game, you can join our discord to give feedback to the administrator. 

Here is the Discord: https://discord.gg/dvqtKXRNzA

-Challenge mode: Create the fastest kill time and the highest kill damage!
